title: The Rift Scar
text: The ground ahead is torn open in a seam of light that hums in your teeth and makes your eyes water. Through it you glimpse other places, other skies. Stones tossed in do not land. The way around is long.

options.label: Step through the humming light, and trust you come out the other side yourselves.

outcomes.text: The light hums through you and is gone. None of you can say what it changed.
The light hums through you, leaving you sharper, as if something on the other side had looked you over and approved.

options.label: Go the long way around. No path is worth walking through another world.

outcomes.text: The long way has its own dangers, and one of them has been waiting patiently for you.
